red.sum: Rodrigo da Vira, navigator aboard the Santa Eliza, leaves Laerta on the expedition to Solanta. This is revealed in ch. 34.
The doge demands the man who knows the channel. Carlos hands over da Vira, who is held in a Solantian prison and sold into slavery.
The Catalian is brought in bonds to the forest camp of enslaved diggers. Joriksen promises freedom for a schönbrun.
Winter in the dugout: the Sorge um dich rite, the fight with the foreman, and the equal division of food.
Water at the thirteenth yard. Greta is the “prize” in place of freedom, and Red flees into the forest.
Yakka brings back the fugitive. The letter goes to Laerta, and Red digs by night, singing.
Red’s cough is gone. The foreman buries him alive in the pit.
The sarcoma is gone. Red recovers at Greta’s house and digs again.
Täuschung: a slaughter on the road, and Landau seizes Red with an unknown power.
Years of executions in the pit, the “THOU SHALT NOT KILL” brand, and Red is taken into the army.
In the army Red is Neubiy, a “stone” rifleman attached to Dietrich’s battery in ch. 2. The platoon of stones flees at night.
Da Vira and the Dangarian deserters live in the House Above with van Halm. He makes a dark schönbrun and takes revenge on the heroes of Solanta.

ditrikh.sum: The battery behind the Ollandian lines: three volleys of grapeshot.
Interrogation by Major Klein at headquarters.

ditrikh.h: Allow Me to Propose a Solution

ditrikh.sum: Joriksen demands that they leave at once. In the compartment, Magnus Amir the Grey tells of the destruction of Dunkwald.
Back in Ollandia: arrested at Latsen station on Klein’s orders, then released.
